common_rules: Freeze the four-task portfolio, starting artifacts, scorer, prompts and resource caps before the first treatment artifact; record hashes.

Every arm gets the same useful task statement, facts, constraints, tools, model and reasoning effort. Native receives normal strong Codex instructions and full resource authorization; do not manufacture a weak prompt.

Do not tell solvers the desired winner, other-arm outputs, hidden test cases or scores. Keep scorer files outside solver input paths and randomize anonymized artifact labels when judging non-executable criteria.
Never reuse a solved portfolio across arms in the same model history. Use fresh contexts and isolated copies; record order to expose warm-cache or order effects.

Call resource control SAME CAPS, not equal realized tokens. Report actual consumption and completion separately. Prompt/protocol reading, U0, helper use and retries count toward all-in treatment cost.

experiment_A.harness: Native collaboration, fork_turns=none; all arms on the same model and reasoning effort

arms.N: Native base instructions plus common task and resource envelope.
arms.L: N plus the literal pinned AGENTS.light.md.
arms.S: Pinned profile with explicit standard parameters N2/R1/D0/V0/L3/M1; source AUTO; simulated U0 decision.

experiment_A.interpretation: Three-arm exploratory comparison of native, light and explicitly selected low profile. S is not the default full treatment. Four tasks within one shared run are a clustered portfolio, not four independent replications. Previous CLI READY probes are instrumentation only, not efficacy observations.

arms.N_extra: Native with the same complete task and extra-resource caps as F.
arms.F_default_capped: Pinned complete profile requesting N12/R4/D3/V3/L3/M1, subject to the same externally imposed cap.

slot_plan: Evaluator root plus one solver Main leaves two helper slots in a four-slot host. Finish methodology agents before starting timed solver episodes.
Use helper cohorts sequentially; preserve each helper identity/history for follow-up. V domains must emerge from actual exploration rather than three prefabricated generic roles.
Three initial domain turns plus three relevant-candidate follow-ups can support three sustained V lines. Those turns do not automatically establish three D interventions.
A helper may produce a genuine nonlocal alternative only when actual research supports it. Record its distinct claim, comparative artifact/evidence and Main consequence before crediting D.
N_extra gets the same optional helpers and turns and may allocate them freely. Do not shorten N_extra to pay for F counting duties.
experiment_B.interpretation: One paired, cap-constrained case study. If F misses substantive obligations, report a truncated/incomplete default-profile run, not completed full DIGR. Do not compare raw results with experiment A as if host and tools were held fixed.

primary_outcomes: Frozen behavioral pass/fail and requirement/scope failures on delivered artifacts, evaluated after solver termination without giving results back to the solver.
All-in wall clock from prompt delivery through the observed final artifact, including U0/protocol overhead; separate solver deadline, harness setup and scoring.
Actual input, cached input, output and reasoning tokens only where the event schema exposes them; total all participating solver sessions, including helper follow-ups.

Tool calls by category only where directly observable, retries/failures, helper identities/turns and concurrency; mark incomplete instrumentation as unknown or partial. Current native log extraction must remain within the explicit metadata whitelist.
caveats: A same-model evaluator can create and run objective tests, but self-authored prose ratings are not independent human validation. Grade observable artifacts, not elaborate traces or stated parameter compliance.
Same wall-clock/concurrency caps do not prove equal compute. No unsupported hard-token cap, subscription dollars or effective-work time may be inferred.
Full-profile input length is part of cost. Count cached tokens separately; do not add reasoning tokens twice when they are already included in output tokens.
A first successful answer and a final improved answer are different outcomes; preserve checkpoint artifacts if assessing useful latency.
If only an additional-resource N/F pair is run, the extra-resource effect of L remains unmeasured.

procedure: Use exact selected native sessions for current trials. CLI READY transport probes produced no task artifacts and are excluded from efficacy outcomes; do not keep retrying unavailable transport for this pilot.
For native trials, record each spawn task_name, returned agent_id and start timestamp in the experiment ledger. A canonical task name is not assumed to be a rollout filename or session ID.

Snapshot only today's session filenames before/after spawning. For newly created candidate files read only the first session_meta record and retain whitelisted id, timestamp and source.subagent.spawn.parent_thread_id.
Select only the explicit trial solver IDs or a proven parent-ID chain from that solver to its helpers. Do not select every descendant of the research root, which includes design/scoring agents.
If identity matching fails, report native usage as unavailable; do not search private historical message bodies for the task name.
Within exact selected files, project only session_meta, turn_context model/effort and event_msg token_count info.total_token_usage. Ignore all reasoning/messages/tool arguments and outputs.

Take the last cumulative usage snapshot per distinct solver session, or final-minus-start for a reused session; do not sum cumulative snapshots. Check monotonicity, missing final snapshots and possible counter resets.
Keep evaluator/root/scorer usage separate. Verify whether parent usage includes child usage before aggregation; do not double-count by assumption.

Under the current metadata-only whitelist, local tool-call counts are not established. Use live trial telemetry or CLI structured item categories; otherwise mark them unknown. A future explicit whitelist could extract only function type/name from exact trial logs, never arguments or outputs.

record_independently_of_quality: Exact pinned version/SHA, manifest/VERSION agreement, full entrypoint/core reads and hash-verification scope. Routing/acquisition success is separate from task-quality benefit.
Original task and explicit parameters, U0 researched brief and actual or explicitly simulated decision provenance, separate foundation/execution boundary and all-in cost.
Effective init configuration, real helper identities and fork_none inputs, actual context boundaries and later information flows.
For N: a meaningful problem and artifact/understanding change. For R: a complete candidate reexamined under a different consequential question, with actual reconsideration and synthesis.
For each D: independent nonlocal claim, researched alternative, returned choice-ready material, Main answer and implemented or justified rejection consequences.
For each V: research-formed domain, its own materials/problems/work, initial contribution and genuine later continuation when relevant candidate changes.
Source responsibility, authentic activity boundaries and clock domains if reported. Wall clock is not T/t; unobserved effective time stays unknown.
Per-unit user-visible boundaries required by the object protocol, final actual-versus-target facts, unresolved scope/permission/stop issues.
insufficient_for_full_execution: Protocol tests pass, files hash correctly, runtime can be loaded, or requested counts are printed.
Six agents or six turns, role labels, a one-shot critique, three generic reviews, or automatic D/V double-credit.
Full-history forks, identical model roleplay in one history, or the Main claiming an independent agent checked an unseen revision.
Splitting commands/tests/log entries into N, checking four files as R4, or calling four task components four whole-candidate restarts.
Pre-U0 work counted toward formal obligations, a confirmed JSON file mistaken for a real user decision, or a cap-stopped run relabeled complete.
faithfulness.simulated_U0: Allowed as a declared system benchmark intervention: freeze a user persona/decision policy, send the same scripted decision and corrections to all applicable arms, record the transcript as SIMULATED. It cannot demonstrate real-user alignment, decision burden, natural clarification quality or genuine user-selected standard mode.

highest_value_cases: Narrow source/version boundary: restore or assemble exactly requested historical material; hidden checks detect unsolicited rewriting and collateral edits.
A deterministic state/race/retry case with an initially plausible wrong explanation; verify actual behavior and preservation of frozen submission identity.
Conflicting frozen evidence with attractive unsupported conclusions; grade source fidelity, missing uncertainty and required facts.
A meaningful mid-task correction delivered at a common candidate checkpoint; check changed action and correction of already-created artifacts, not acknowledgment.
A simple negative-control task to reveal overhead, plus an unavailable-capability case to detect false D/V/completion claims; keep efficacy and failure-behavior analyses separate.
minimum_practical_reporting: The planned two repeated portfolio runs per N/L/S arm and one native N/F pair are a feasibility pilot, not a general causal proof.
Report every task-by-arm outcome, repeat variability, paired discordances, all-in costs, timeout/incomplete runs and treatment deviations. Do not silently drop failed transport or protocol runs.

Do not call eight task results eight independent trials when they share a portfolio/context. With four distinct tasks and tiny replication, uncertainty is large; use raw paired counts and ranges instead of a misleading single significance claim.
A promising follow-up should add genuinely new task instances and independent repeats, ideally at least six distinct tasks and two repeats per arm, before broad value claims.

A frozen-case counterexample can falsify an absolute claim that the profile always improves results. A few wins cannot establish general benefit; a null result under a short cap cannot show a fully executed profile has no benefit.
